$comment: Respellings applied to the narration before it reaches the TTS engine,
and nowhere else — the captions keep the real spelling.
Matching is whole-word and case-insensitive, longest key first, so a
longer phrase always beats a shorter one it contains.
Add an entry the first time you hear a name said wrong. That is cheaper
than re-recording and it applies to every future release video.
Changing a value invalidates only the cached WAVs that contain it.
